scripts.build:contracts: bun run --cwd packages/contracts clean && bun run --cwd packages/contracts build
scripts.build:roma-kernel: bun run --cwd packages/roma-kernel clean && bun run --cwd packages/roma-kernel build
scripts.build:contracts:npm: cd packages/contracts && npm run clean && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:roma-kernel && bun run build:web
scripts.build:bun: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:roma-kernel && bun run build:web
scripts.cf:build: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:roma-kernel && bun run --cwd apps/web cf:build
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: cd apps/web && bunx wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.toml
scripts.cf:deploy:prod: cd apps/web && bunx wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run --outdir .open-next/deploy && node scripts/patch-bundle-require.cjs && OPEN_NEXT_DEPLOY=true bunx wrangler deploy --env production --no-bundle --config wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.test: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:roma-kernel && bun run --cwd apps/web test
